patterns.note: Full-width sections with content consistently centered and constrained, often using three-column grids for features and news.
Prominent, extra-large sans-serif headings in the hero section, transitioning to bold, structured headings for subsequent content.
A high-contrast, two-tone palette featuring a deep, dark green for backgrounds and a bright, vibrant light green for accents and calls to action.
A sticky navigation bar that dynamically changes from transparent with white text over the hero to a solid white background with dark text and logo upon scrolling.
Asymmetrical two-column content blocks, such as a large video player paired with a concise text description.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text legibility. The main navigation bar is initially transparent over the hero, then transitions to a solid white background with dark text and logo as the user scrolls down the page.

Content is structured within centered, fixed-width containers, often employing responsive three-column grids for feature lists and news articles, or a two-column split for specific content like embedded videos with accompanying text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4x body) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, and on content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, while content grids maintain a clear, organized rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, muted forest green as a dominant background color, contrasted sharply with a vibrant, almost neon, light green for accents and calls to action, creates a unique and memorable brand identity that feels both modern and grounded in nature.
